notes.title: Legend Scouting Event
notes.content:
Hello, fellow presidents! The much-anticipated legendary scout will be launched on November 29. This event will launch the legendary player Zidane with a new rating upgrade and no trial required. Chairman, please come and take a look at this legendary scout!

[h3] Preview of exciting content:[/h3]
1. This issue introduces the legendary player Zidane. Legendary players are divided into 3 qualities: ordinary/rare/peak. The higher the quality, the rarer and more powerful they are!

2. At the same time, you can also get superstar fragment packs, style enhancement cards, massive diamonds and other rare resources!
3. You can get 1 lucky point every time you draw, and you can receive rare lucky value rewards for every 20 lucky points!

[h3]Activity time:[/h3]
November 29th 00:00-December 4th 00:00
[h3]Scope of activity:[/h3]
All servers whose server opening time is >7 days can participate.
[h3]Player level:[/h3]
Player level ≥20

[h3]Event 1: Limited time gift pack[/h3]
Event time: November 29th 00:00 - December 4th 00:00
[h3]Activity 2: Cumulative rewards[/h3]
Event time: November 29th 00:00 - December 4th 00:00
You can get 1 lucky point and permanent mark value for each draw. If you accumulate lucky points and mark values ​​to a certain amount, you can get legendary player fragments!

Dear Presidents, don’t miss this opportunity, come and join us!

notes.title: Time-limited scouting event is coming
notes.content:
Dear Chairman, hello, the limited-time scouting event is coming. We will launch 31 top superstars and 15 purple card players in this event. There are also rare resources such as top player fragments waiting for you to find out!

Wonderful preview: the peak is coming again, the new superstar will be sent for a limited time This event will launch: Pepe, Diego Costa, Higuain, Muller and other 31 peak superstars, as well as Messi and other 12 purple card players!

Time-limited merchant, selling limited-time scouting coupons at a super value

[h2]Activity time:June 27th 00:00-July 1st 00:00[/h2]
Closing time for prize collection: 00:00, July 2
Player Level:
Player level > 10

[b]Event 1: Limited Time Scouting[/b]
Activity time: 00:00, June 27th - 00:00, July 1st
Time-limited scouting is open. After players click the Icon above the main interface to participate in the main interface, use the limited-time scout coupon for single draw/ten draw!
Players can have the opportunity to draw rewards such as 31 top superstar packs, 15 purple card star packs, annual player fragment packs, and 86+ flash gold fragment packs.

Players can obtain limited-time scouting coupons through diamond purchases, recharges, and active logins.
At the same time, consumption of time-limited scouting coupons will give you ranking points. After the event ends, players will get leaderboard rewards based on the points. The rewards are 1 pack of 31 peak superstars and 1 pack of 15 purple card stars!

[b]Event 2: Time-limited purchase[/b]
Activity time: 00:00, June 30th - 00:00, July 1st
During the event period, we have prepared a new limited-time purchase gift package for you, come and have a look!

notes.title: "Soccer Clubs" alliance gameplay
notes.content:
[h3] Share my league experience with managers today. [/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/5840e98172a8b44ecce343c34d27f645405ba202.png[/img]

There is an alliance under the team on the joining page of the alliance. Click to enter and you can choose to create an alliance. You can choose your favorite badge and name, and you can also set whether it needs to be reviewed. The level limit of the application can also be set. As long as the alliance management is set, Very easy to manage.
Next, we enter the alliance. The first thing we see is the headquarters building of the alliance. Inside, we can see who is offline for too long or who has not contributed. You can impeach him even if the president has not been around for a long time, and invite him down.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/cb468c9ea2f1c08d8f84b40037d560372f863055.png[/img]

There is a youth training center on the right. Click to enter the youth training report for the youth training players. In the lower right corner, you can draw a lottery for youth training coins. The youth training coins are used to shoot players. There are gold cards and flash gold. Then there is the training policy of the youth training players, which has an impact on the weekly output of the youth training players' ratings. Youth coaches and mentors can have an impact on this. The facilities are related to the various technological levels of the alliance, and they will be automatically opened when they meet the requirements. The youth training market is produced every Monday and the youth training players are auctioned off last week. I have photographed Varane in 20001. Every player has an estimate. If the auction fails, it will enter the server-wide auction on Tuesday, and the income will be shared equally among union members.
The building in the lower right corner of the alliance is a store, with alliance level rewards, where you can get various development materials, flash card coach fragments, etc. When the alliance reaches the fourth and fifth levels, there will be pieces of the goalkeeper, which can be bought every day.
The middle and lower buildings are office buildings where you can submit tasks and receive contribution progress rewards.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43302601/dd8a947b3f18362a8cbedf079de712ca73d2a411.png[/img]

On the left is the research institute, which can respectively improve the court damage reduction, transfer share, player attributes, arena recovery, league store level, and arena damage bonus.
The alliance task gives gifts three times a day, and you can get alliance research and development points, physical strength and alliance contribution. Allies receive special training coupons and alliance contributions.
